english.note: Use this for the spatial area or scope covered by something rather than its degree or intensity.
This is the all-purpose choice for the breadth, extent, or applicability of a subject.
Use this for the scope, extent, or range of a subject, object, or concept rather than a physical place.
Use this for a sphere understood as an area of activity, authority, or influence.
Use this for an approximate range or span rather than a geographic territory.
